ja: 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2199』物語の序盤のみどころ“メ号作戦”を再現できる 1/1000スケールプラモデル２２隻＋αが
スペシャルセットになって プレミアムバンダイに登場！！
• “メ号作戦”に参加した２２隻に加え、特典として同スケールの村雨型宇宙巡洋艦が３隻付属。
この３隻は“メ号作戦”にどう関係するのか？！？ すべては、付属の｢設定小冊子｣で明らかに！
• HOW TOなどの記事を含む｢設定小冊子｣付属！
• 豪華箔押し仕様の‘スペシャルボックス’仕様！
〈セット内容〉
● １／１０００スケールプラモデル 全２２隻
・ 金剛型宇宙戦艦　１隻 （キリシマ）
・ 村雨型宇宙巡洋艦 ９隻（ユウギリ、アタゴ、アブクマ、ヤクモ、クラマ、ツルギ、イブキ、ムラクモ、ナチ）
・ 磯風型突撃宇宙駆逐艦　１２隻（ユキカゼ、シマカゼ、アヤナミ、シキナミ、シラヌイ、ハツシマ、アヤセ、イソカゼ、カゲロウ、タチカゼ、
フユツキ、ミナツキ）
● 特典：１／１０００スケールプラモデル 全３隻
・ 村雨型宇宙巡洋艦　３隻 （名称未発表）
● 専用台座（１隻づつの独立ディスプレイ式）※
● 専用マーキングシール（水転写式）及び専用台座用シール（ホイルシール）

en: ``Space Battleship Yamato 2199'' 22 1/1000 Scale plastic models + α that can reproduce the highlight of the story ``Operation Me''
Now available in Premium Bandai as a special set! !
• In addition to the 22 ships that participated in “Operation Me”, three Murasame-class space cruisers of the same scale are included as a bonus.
How are these three ships related to “Operation Me”? ! ? Everything is revealed in the included "Settings Booklet"!
• "Settings booklet" including articles such as HOW TO is included!
• ‘Special box’ specification with luxurious foil stamping!
<Set contents>
● 1/1000 scale plastic model total 22 ships
・One Kongo-class space battleship (Kirishima)
・9 Murasame-class space cruisers (Yugiri, Atago, Abukuma, Yakumo, Kurama, Tsurugi, Ibuki, Murakumo, Nachi)
- 12 Isokaze-class assault space destroyers (Yukikaze, Shimakaze, Ayanami, Shikinami, Shiranui, Hatsushima, Ayase, Isokaze, Kagerou, Tachikaze,
Fuyutsuki, Minatsuki)
● Bonus: 3 1/1000 Scale plastic models
・Three Murasame-class space cruisers (names unannounced)
● Dedicated pedestal (independent display type for each boat)*
● Exclusive Marking Seal (water transfer type) and exclusive pedestal seal (foil seal)
● Settings booklet
*The special pedestal is not designed to allow multiple pieces to be displayed as a collective display.
* The molding color of the pedestal is black. (White pedestal is not included) [Added on 2013/06/01]
1/1000Scale assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product material: PS
Assembly requires adhesive (sold separately)
*The finished product and package in the photo are prototypes still in development.
*The finished product in the photo is painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
